protocol.split: per-user chronological 60/20/20; timestamp groups kept together
protocol.profile: first 60% frozen for both validation and test; no holdout refit
protocol.text: only tags at/before training cutoff; evaluation user's tags excluded; vocabulary/IDF/SVD fit on history movies only
protocol.selection: macro validation pairwise accuracy; RMSE tie-break
protocol.embeddings: LSA fit on training TF-IDF; not a pretrained semantic model
protocol.metrics: user-macro pairwise and NDCG@10 (exponential gains, averaged score ties); RMSE=sqrt(mean per-user MSE); MAE=user-macro
protocol.candidate_set: rated held-out movies only; not full-catalog retrieval evaluation
